title: Loops and Graphs (@hanakoxbt)
description: Based on @hanakoxbt's Loops and Graphs architecture: split a feature into test-first units, run bounded intra-node loops sequentially in the current worktree, verify deterministically, accept through one human gate, and feed lessons back to the splitter.
author: hanakoxbt

params.label: Max Feature Units
params.description: Upper limit (1-6) on how many vertical units the splitter plans per feature run.

zh-CN.label: 最大拆分单元数
zh-CN.description: 单次交付工作流拆分器允许规划的最大垂直单元数量（1–6）。

params.label: Full Check Command
params.description: Deterministic verification command run before the human acceptance gate.

zh-CN.label: 全量检查命令
zh-CN.description: 进入人工验收闸门前执行的确定性验证命令。
zh-CN.placeholder: 例如：pnpm test（留空则由拆分器自动探测）

params.label: Environment Setup Command
params.description: Dependency/bootstrap command before workers start (auto, custom shell command, or empty to skip).

zh-CN.label: 环境初始化命令
zh-CN.description: Worker 执行前运行的环境初始化命令（auto / 自定义命令 / 留空跳过）。

params.label: Review Check Command
params.description: Optional verification command executed alongside the parallel Code Review preset.

zh-CN.label: 并行审查检查命令
zh-CN.description: 运行并行代码审查预设时附带执行的检查命令。

en.title: Loops and Graphs (@hanakoxbt)
en.description: Based on @hanakoxbt's Loops and Graphs architecture: split a feature into test-first units, run bounded intra-node loops sequentially in the current worktree, verify deterministically, accept through one human gate, and feed lessons back to the splitter.

zh-CN.title: Loops & Graphs 工作台 (@hanakoxbt)
zh-CN.description: 基于 @hanakoxbt《Loops and Graphs》工作流架构的实时拓扑台：将需求拆为先写测试的垂直单元，在当前 Worktree 顺序执行与有限纠错循环，确定性归并后经唯一人工闸门确认交付，并把经验沉淀为约束回流到拆分器。
